Rashi on Pesachim 83a:10:1.hebrew: לא היתה לו שעת הכושר - כגון נטמא לפני זריקה, אין בו משום שבירת עצם:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:10:1.english: It did not have a time when it was valid - For example, [if] it became ritually impure before the sprinkling [of the blood], it is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:10:2.hebrew: ומאן ניהו תנא - דמתני' דשאני ליה בהכי לגבי שבירת העצם:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:10:2.english: And who is the tanna - of the Mishnah who differentiates in this [matter] regarding breaking the bone.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:11:1.hebrew: כל עצמות - נותר מן הקדשים אין טעונין שריפה, אלא שוברם ומוציא את המוח ושורפו, ומשליך את העצמות:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:11:1.english: All bones - [that are] leftover from offerings do not require burning; rather, one breaks them, removes the marrow and burns it, and discards the bones.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:11:2.hebrew: חוץ מעצמות הפסח - שאין יכול לשוברן מפני תקלת "עצם לא תשברו בו", לפיכך נשרפים על ידי מוח שבהן:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:11:2.english: Except for the bones of the Paschal lamb - For one cannot break them due to the mishap [of transgressing], "You shall not break a bone in it"; therefore, they are burned on account of the marrow that is in them.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:11:3.english: Why do they [require] burning - For the bones of the Paschal lamb.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:12:1.hebrew: שמצאן חלוצין - כולה מתני' מיתוקמא במוצא עצמות חלוצין, כלומר שבורין ונחלץ מוח מהן:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:12:1.english: Where one found them extracted - The entire Mishnah is established [as referring to] one who finds extracted bones, that is to say, broken [bones] from which marrow has been extracted.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:12:2.hebrew: עצמות קדשים - דמותר לשוברן, אמרי' סתמא דמילתא לא אתא מוח דידהו לידי נותר, ומקמיה איסורייהו דניתו לידי נותר חלצינהו, ואין כאן שימוש נותר:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:12:2.english: Bones of offerings - Since it is permitted to break them, we say as a general rule [that] their marrow did not come to [the state of] notar [leftover], and before their prohibition — that they would come to [be] notar — one removed [the marrow from] them, so there is no serving [as a base for] notar here.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:13:1.hebrew: לבתר הכי - דאיפסיל, חלצינהו, דתו לית ביה איסור שבירה כר"ש, ויש כאן שימוש נותר:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:13:1.english: After this - [That is, after] they became disqualified, one removed [the marrow from] them, for there is no longer a prohibition of breaking [a bone] in it, in accordance with Rabbi Shimon, and there is here service of leftover [meat].

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:1:1.hebrew: ורבה מוסיף אף רבי יוסי - נמי סבירא ליה כר' יוחנן בן ברוקה, דפסול בעלים לא בעי עיבור צורה:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:1:1.english: And Rabba adds: Even Rabbi Yosei - [he] too holds like Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka, that a disqualification [relating to] the owners does not require disfigurement of form [waiting overnight before burning].

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:1:2.hebrew: כל הענין כולו - כל פרשה זו, וכל חטאת אשר יובא מדמה (ויקרא ו׳:כ״ג), דמוקי לה רבנן במסכת זבחים (דף פב.) בחטאת החיצונה שהכניס דמה לפנים, וזהו פסול שלה, וקאמר רחמנא שישרף — פליג ריה"ג ומוקי בחטאת הפנימית, כגון פר העלם דבר של ציבור, אשר יובא מדמה כמצותה אל אהל מועד, לא תאכל באש תשרף. (ובבשרה) לא איצטריך קרא, דהא כתיב בגופיה (ויקרא ד׳:י״ב) ושרף אותו על עצים וגו', אלא שאם נפסלה ביוצא ובטומאה, בא הכתוב ללמדך שתשרפנה בבית הבירה ולא חוץ לג' מחנות כמצות', וליתן לא תעשה על אכילתה:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:1:2.english: The entire matter - This entire passage — "And any sin-offering from which some blood is brought..." (Leviticus 6:23) — which the Rabbis establish in tractate Zevachim (82a) [as referring] to an outer sin-offering whose blood was brought inside, and that is its disqualification, and the Merciful One says that it shall be burned — Rabbi Yosei HaGelili disagrees and establishes [it as referring] to an inner sin-offering, such as the bull for a communal error, whose blood is brought in accordance with its mitzvah into the Tent of Meeting: "it shall not be eaten; it shall be burned in fire." (And regarding its flesh,) a verse is not needed, for it is already written in [the passage] itself (Leviticus 4:12), "And he shall burn it on wood, etc." Rather, [it teaches] that if it became disqualified by going outside [its prescribed area] or through ritual impurity, Scripture comes to teach you that you shall burn it in the beit habirah and not outside the three camps as [is] its mitzvah, and to establish a negative commandment against eating it.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:2:1.english: They said to him: An outer sin-offering whose blood one brought inside, from where [do you derive it] - that it is disqualified.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:2:2.hebrew: אמר להן - מדאמר ליה משה לאהרן הן לא הובא, הא הובא — בת שריפה היא, ושפיר עביד דשרפוה לאלתר. ומדיליף ריה"ג קדשי דורות מחטאת דאהרן, אלמא ס"ל נמי דאם הובא דמה לדורות, בעיא שריפה לאלתר כי חטאת דאהרן, ואף על גב דפסול הדם הוא דהוי כפסולו מחמת דבר אחר. וקס"ד דה"ה נמי ס"ל בפסול בעלים, דלא בעי עיבור צורה. אבל רבנן דלא גמירי מיניה, סברי דורות משעה לא ילפינן, ובההיא הוא דקאמר להו משה דאם הביאו דמה לפנים בעיא שריפה, אבל לדורות בעי קרא אחרינא, וגבי עיבור צורה נמי לא ילפינן מינה:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:2:2.english: He said to them - Since Moses said to Aaron, "Behold, [its blood] was not brought [into the Sanctuary]," [this implies that] had it been brought, it would be subject to burning, and [they] acted properly in burning it immediately. And since Rabbi Yosei HaGelili derives [the law for] consecrated offerings of future generations from the sin-offering of Aaron, apparently he also holds that if its blood is brought [inside] in future generations, it requires burning immediately like the sin-offering of Aaron, even though it is a disqualification of the blood, which is like a disqualification on account of something else. And we initially assumed that he holds the same regarding a disqualification of the owners, that it does not require decay of form. However, the Rabbis, who do not derive [from it], hold [that] we do not derive [laws for] future generations from a temporary ruling, and it was [only] regarding that [case] that Moses said to them that if they brought its blood inside it requires burning, whereas for future generations another verse is required; and regarding decay of form as well, we do not derive [from it].

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:3:1.hebrew: ור' יוחנן - דלא חשיב ליה לריה"ג בהדייהו, אמר לך: נהי דשמעת ליה בפסול דם דלא בעו עיבור צורה, בפסול בעלים מי שמעת ליה דקאי כרבי יוחנן בן ברוקה:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:3:1.english: And Rabbi Yoḥanan - who did not count Rabbi Yosei HaGelili among them, says to you: Granted that you heard him [say] regarding a disqualification of the blood that they do not require decay of form, [but] regarding a disqualification of the owners, did you hear him [say] that he holds like Rabbi Yoḥanan ben Beroka?

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:3:2.hebrew: דם ובשר חדא מילתא היא - והוה ליה פסולו בגופו, כאילו נטמא בשר עצמו:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:3:2.english: Blood and meat are one matter - And [thus] its disqualification is [considered] in its body, as if the meat itself became impure.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:4:1.hebrew: העצמות - שלא יכול לשוברן מפני שנאסרה בו שבירת העצם, ונותר בהן מוח, והרי הוא נותר וטעון שריפה:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:4:1.english: The bones - For one could not break them because the breaking of a bone is forbidden in [the Paschal lamb], and marrow remained in them, so it is leftover [notar] and requires burning.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:4:2.english: And similarly, [the] sinews - And in the Gemara it asks: Let us eat them?

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:4:3.english: And the leftover - Meat of the Paschal lamb that they were remiss in eating, and it remained left over.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:4:4.hebrew: בששה עשר - שהוא חולו של מועד, ואע"פ שנפסל בבוקר ראשון, אין רשאי לשורפו בי"ט, כדמפרש בגמר':
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:4:4.english: On the sixteenth - Which is Chol HaMoed [the intermediate days of the Festival], and even though it became disqualified on the first morning, one is not permitted to burn it on the Festival, as [it] explains in the Gemara.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:5:1.hebrew: ששימשו נותר - שנותר בהן מוח חוץ לזמנו, ושימשוהו העצמות הללו:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:5:1.english: That served leftover - That marrow remained in them beyond its [permitted] time, and these bones served it.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:5:2.hebrew: מטמאין את הידים - כנותר עצמו, שגזרו חכמים שיטמא את הידים בפ' בתרא (דף קכ:), ולקמן בפירקין (פסחים דף פה.) מייתי לה בגמ':
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:5:2.english: They render hands impure - Like leftover [sacrificial meat] itself, which the Sages decreed renders the hands impure, in the last chapter [of this tractate] (120b); and later in our chapter (Pesachim 85a), it is cited in the Gemara.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:5:3.hebrew: בסיס - כנו, כדמתרגמי' בסיסיה (שמות ל), מקום מושבו:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:5:3.english: A base [basis] - Its stand [kanno], as we translate [kanno in] Exodus 30 [into Aramaic as] besiseih, the place where it rests.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:6:1.english: What are the circumstances [of] these bones - That [the Mishnah] states [that] their essence and their beginning [are] for burning.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:6:2.hebrew: נשדינהו - ישליכם, דלא הצריך הכתוב שריפה אלא בראוי לאכילה וניתותר, כדכתיב (שם יב): "לא תותירו ממנו עד בקר", ואם תותירו, תשרפו:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:6:2.english: We should discard them - [Meaning] one should throw them away, for Scripture required burning only for [something] fit for eating that was left over, as it is written (ibid. 12): "You shall not leave any of it until morning," and if you leave [any] over, you shall burn [it].

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:6:3.hebrew: דאית בהו מוח - ומתחלתן לשריפה עומדים, שאסור לשוברן, וע"כ נעשין נותר. הילכך, חשיב להו באנפי נפשייהו, ולא הוו בכלל והנותר דמתני':
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:6:3.english: That have marrow in them - And from the outset they stand to be burned, since it is forbidden to break them, and perforce they become leftover [sacrificial meat (*notar*)]. Therefore, [the Tanna] counts them separately, and they are not included in "and the leftover" of the Mishnah.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:7:1.english: Because of this they require burning - Even the bones [require burning], like the marrow itself.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:7:2.hebrew: אלא אי לאו מילתא היא - הרי מכיון שניתותרו ונפסלו, אין בהן משום איסור שבירה, דאמרינן לקמן: "ועצם לא תשברו בו" — בכשר, ולא בפסול:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:7:2.english: But if [it] is nothing [significant] - Behold, once [the bones] have become leftover and disqualified, they are not subject to the prohibition of breaking [a bone], as we say later: "And you shall not break a bone in it" — [this applies] to a valid [offering], and not to a disqualified [one].

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:7:3.hebrew: ניתברינהו - ונישקליה למוח ונישרפיה, ולא יפסיד עצים וטורח לשרוף העצמות:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:7:3.english: Let us break them - And take out the marrow and burn it, and [thus] not waste wood and effort to burn the bones.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:8:1.hebrew: קסבר - האי תנא, "בו" דכתיב גבי שבירה לאו למעוטי פסול אתא, אלא אורחיה דקרא הוא, וכשר ואף פסול במשמע:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:8:1.english: He holds - this Tanna [holds that the word] "in it," which is written regarding breaking [a bone], did not come to exclude a disqualified [Paschal lamb]; rather, it is the [normal] way of Scripture, and [both] a valid [one] and even a disqualified [one] are implied.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:9:1.english: One who leaves over [from] a pure [Paschal lamb] - And all the more so [from] an impure [one].

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:9:2.english: Does not receive [lashes] - Later in our chapter, [the Gemara] explains the reason.

Rashi on Pesachim 83a:9:3.hebrew: היתה לו שעת הכושר - כגון נותר, יש בו שבירת העצם:
Rashi on Pesachim 83a:9:3.english: It had a time when it was valid - Such as leftover [sacrificial meat], [the prohibition of] breaking the bone applies to it.

Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:10:1.hebrew: רבי שמעון אומר אחד זה ואחד זה אין בו משום שבירת העצם - וא"ת: ר"ש היינו ת"ק? ונראה לר"י, דר' יעקב ור"ש פליגי אליבא דת"ק, כי ההיא ד"לא ירבה לו נשים" דפרק כהן גדול (סנהדרין כא.), וההיא ד"חזקתן שלש שנים" דחזקת הבתים (ב"ב כח:):
Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:10:1.english: Rabbi Shimon says: [With regard to] both this and that, it is not subject to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone - And if you ask: Rabbi Shimon is [saying the same thing as] the Tanna Kamma? And it appears to Ri [Rabbeinu Yitzchak] that Rabbi Ya'akov and Rabbi Shimon are arguing according to [the view of] the Tanna Kamma, like that [case] of "he shall not multiply wives for himself" in the chapter Kohen Gadol (Sanhedrin 21a), and that [case] of "their presumptive ownership is three years" in [the chapter] Chezkat HaBatim (Bava Batra 28b).

Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:13:1.hebrew: אימור לבתר איסורא חלצינהו - ו"מפני התקלה" דקתני בברייתא — היינו דמשום שבירת עצם לא חלצינהו קודם איסורא, ולהכי ישרפו דשימשו נותר:
Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:13:1.english: Say [that] after the prohibition [of notar took effect] they removed [the marrow from] them - And "because of the stumbling block" that the Baraita teaches means that due to [the prohibition of] breaking a bone, they did not remove [the marrow from] them before the prohibition [of notar], and therefore they must be burned because they served [as a base for] notar.

Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:1:1.hebrew: ורבה מוסיף אף ריה"ג - וא"ת: היכי נימא דריה"ג ור' יוחנן בן ברוקה אמרו דבר אחד, והא פסולה דחטאת שנכנס דמה לפנים היינו לפני זריקה, ור' יוחנן בן ברוקה אחר זריקה איירי, ואליבא דר' יוחנן מסיק, מדקא מוסיף עלי'? וי"ל: דרבה לא מפליג בין קודם זריקה בין לאחר זריקה, כי היכי דלא מפליג ר' יוחנן, דקאמר: אף אחר זריקה מחלוקת:
Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:1:1.english: And Rabba adds: Even Rabbi Yosei HaGelili [agrees] - And if you ask: How can we say that Rabbi Yosei HaGelili and Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka said the same thing, given that the disqualification of a sin-offering whose blood entered inside [the Sanctuary] is before sprinkling, whereas Rabbi Yochanan ben Beroka is speaking about [a disqualification] after sprinkling — and [Rabba] is concluding [his statement] in accordance with Rabbi Yochanan, since he adds onto his [statement]? One can answer that Rabba does not distinguish between before sprinkling and after sprinkling, just as Rabbi Yochanan does not distinguish, as he says: Even after sprinkling there is a dispute.

Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:2:1.hebrew: אמר להן הן לא הובא את דמה - פירש בקונטריס דרבנן לא בעו למילף מחטאת דאהרן, דלא גמרי' דורות משעה. ומה שפירש כן — לא משום דחטאת דאהרן היה לשעה, דהא שעיר של ר"ח היה, כדפירש בקונ', וכן איתא בזבחים בפרק טבול יום (זבחים דף קא:); אלא דקסברי רבנן הוראת שעה היתה, כדאמר לעיל. וקשה לרשב"א: דלעיל שייך הוראת שעה כדפי', דקסבר מפני טומאה נשרפה, דהוי פסולו בגופו ומסברא ישרף מיד; אבל הכא, בחטאת שנכנס דמה לפנים, דהוי פסולו בדם ומסבר' בעי עיבור צורה — לא שייך הוראת שעה היתה. ונראה לר"י: דרבנן לא בעו למילף מחטאת אהרן, משום דמצינו למימר דמשה לא הודה להן על השריפה דשפיר עבוד, אלא במה שלא אכלוה; אבל על השריפה לא הודה להן, דאפי' היה כן — שלא כדין שרפוה בלא עיבור צורה. וקשה: דלעיל יליף מחטאת אהרן שריפה ביוצא, וקאי אמתני' דסבר' דשאינו פסולו בגופו בעי עיבור צורה, והיינו כרבנן דר' יוסי — ואינהו לא בעו למילף הכא מחטאת אהרן:
Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:2:1.english: He said to them: "Behold, its blood was not brought [into the Sanctuary within]" - Rashi explained that the Rabbis do not want to derive [the law] from Aaron's sin-offering, because we do not derive [laws for future] generations from a temporary [one-time] case. And that which [Rashi] explained thus [is] not because Aaron's sin-offering [itself] was [a sacrifice] for that occasion [only], for it was the goat of the New Moon, as Rashi explained, and so it is found in Zevachim in the chapter Tevul Yom (Zevachim 101b); rather, [it is] because the Rabbis hold [its burning] was a temporary ruling, as [the Gemara] stated above. And it is difficult for Rashba: For above, [the concept of] a temporary ruling is applicable, as explained, since he holds it was burned because of impurity — which is a disqualification in its [own] body, and logically it should be burned immediately; but here, regarding a sin-offering whose blood entered inside, which is a disqualification in the blood and logically requires decay of form — [the explanation that] "it was a temporary ruling" is not applicable. And it appears to Ri: That the Rabbis do not want to derive [the law] from Aaron's sin-offering because we can say that Moses did not agree with them regarding the burning — that they acted properly — [but] only regarding [the fact] that they did not eat it; however, regarding the burning, he did not agree with them, for even if it were so [that its blood had been brought inside], they burned it unlawfully without decay of form. And it is difficult: For above, [the Gemara] derives from Aaron's sin-offering [immediate] burning for [an offering] that went out [beyond its permitted area], and it is addressing the Mishnah, which holds that [an offering] whose disqualification is not in its [own] body requires decay of form — and that is in accordance with the Rabbis [who dispute] Rabbi Yosei [HaGelili] — yet here they do not want to derive from Aaron's sin-offering.

Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:8:1.hebrew: בו בכשר ואפי' בפסול - ולא תיקשי: ויוציא המוח ע"י גומרתא, דליכא שבירת עצם — דאיכא למיחש שמא יפקע, כדאמרי' לקמן; אי נמי, ע"י גומרתא טריחא מילתא למיעבד:
Tosafot on Pesachim 83a:8:1.english: "In it" [applies] to a valid [Paschal lamb], and even to a disqualified [one] - And do not ask: let him extract the marrow by means of a glowing coal, where there is no breaking of a bone — for there is [reason] to be concerned lest it split, as we say later; alternatively, [doing so] by means of a glowing coal is a burdensome thing to do.
